stem: Dehumidification holds target RH when lights are on but loses control soon after lights-off. Which explanation should be tested first?
choices: The latent/sensible load balance and equipment capacity change across operating states
Only nutrient EC can cause the transition
The room average during lights-on proves capacity is sufficient at all times
rationale: Lighting state changes heat load and plant/environment dynamics. Capacity should be evaluated across the full operating cycle, including transition periods.
